1) we created a novel inducible mouse model of obesity that allows us to study the lineage mechanisms of obesity-induced beta cell proliferation without developmental compensation or concurrent hyperglycaemia, 2) we demonstrate that self-renewal of beta cells is the primary mechanism by which beta cell mass increases in obesity, and 3) we demonstrate that the rate of beta cell proliferation is limited by the replication refractory phase, even during extreme obesity
